Rainbow elements use the classic six-stripe rainbow palette in dense satin stitch. Thick twisted rainbow rope border around the circular patch edge. Embroidered iron-on patch, hand-sewn look, ultra-detailed macro embroidery rendering: individual thread strands clearly visible, raised stitch relief catching soft studio light, subtle textile sheen. Centered composition, full circular design entirely visible with a clear margin of dark felt all around. The patch contains no other words besides the slogan, no watermark, no logos.
